<style>
:root{
  --bg:#ffffff; --band:#f3f6fa; --line:#dde3ec; --ink:#0f1f3a; --muted:#52627a;
  --accent:#1f4e8c; --accent-dark:#163a69;
  --serif:"Source Serif 4",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --sans:"Source Sans 3",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:4.5rem}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:1.125rem;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:var(--accent);text-underline-offset:3px}
a:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-999px;top:0;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:.6rem 1rem;z-index:100}
.skip:focus{left:0}
.wrap{max-width:68rem;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem}

header.bar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:3.6rem;gap:1rem}
.brand{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:600;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
.brand:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.bar nav ul{display:flex;gap:1.6rem;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.bar nav a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;padding:.2rem 0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}
.bar nav a:hover,.bar nav a[aria-current="true"]{color:var(--ink);border-bottom-color:var(--accent)}
.menu{display:none;width:2.4rem;height:2.4rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.4rem;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer}

/* hero */
.hero{background:var(--band);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:15rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:3rem;padding-top:4rem;padding-bottom:4rem;align-items:start}
.photo{width:15rem;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:.4rem;overflow:hidden;background:#dbe4f0;border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:3.4rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent)}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2.3rem,5vw,3.5rem);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0 0 .5rem}
.pos{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2vw,1.4rem);color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 1.3rem;font-weight:500}
.lead{max-width:40rem;margin:0 0 1.6rem;color:#27374f}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:max-content minmax(0,1fr);gap:.35rem 1.4rem;margin:0 0 1.8rem;font-size:1rem}
.facts dt{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.facts dd{margin:0}
.cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.8rem}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:.65rem 1.25rem;border-radius:.35rem;font-weight:600;font-size:1rem;text-decoration:none;border:1.5px solid var(--accent);transition:background .15s,color .15s}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.btn.primary:hover{background:var(--accent-dark);border-color:var(--accent-dark);color:#fff}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--accent)}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}

/* sections: heading in the margin column, content on the right */
section.s{padding:3.6rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
section.s:last-of-type{border-bottom:0}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:13rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:3rem}
h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:600;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1.2;margin:0}
.row>div>p.intro{margin:0 0 1.6rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:40rem}

.areas{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:0}
.areas li{padding:1.1rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.areas li:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.areas h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 .25rem}
.areas p{margin:0;color:#34455f}

.jobs{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.job{display:grid;grid-template-columns:9.5rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:1.5rem;padding:1.4rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.job:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.when{color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem;padding-top:.15rem}
.job h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:600;margin:0}
.where{color:var(--accent);margin:.1rem 0 .55rem;font-size:1rem}
.job ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.1rem;color:#27374f;font-size:1.02rem}
.job li{padding-bottom:.2rem}

.skillrows{margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:11rem minmax(0,1fr);gap:0}
.skillrows dt,.skillrows dd{padding:.85rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:0}
.skillrows dt:first-of-type,.skillrows dt:first-of-type+dd{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.skillrows dt{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:600}
.skillrows dd{color:#27374f}

.refs{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;counter-reset:ref}
.refs li{counter-increment:ref;position:relative;padding:1rem 0 1rem 2.6rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.refs li:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.refs li:first-child::before{top:.05rem}
.refs li::before{content:"[" counter(ref) "]";position:absolute;left:0;top:1.05rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem}
.refs a.t{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
.refs a.t:hover{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:underline}
.refs .by{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem;margin-top:.15rem}
.refs em{font-family:var(--serif)}
.note{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;margin:1.2rem 0 0}

.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:2rem}
.cols h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 .8rem}
.plain{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.plain li{padding:.6rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600}
.plain li:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.plain span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.97rem;font-weight:400}

.contact p{margin:0 0 1.2rem;max-width:36rem;color:#27374f}
footer{background:var(--ink);color:#c5d0e2;padding:2rem 0;font-size:.95rem}
footer .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:.5rem}

@media (max-width:56rem){
  .menu{display:block}
  .bar nav{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:3.6rem;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:none}
  .bar nav.open{display:block}
  .bar nav ul{flex-direction:column;gap:0;padding:.4rem 1.5rem 1rem}
  .bar nav a{display:block;padding:.6rem 0}
  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.6rem;padding-top:2.5rem;padding-bottom:2.8rem}
  .photo{width:10rem}
  .row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.2rem}
  .cols{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:36rem){
  .job{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.1rem}
  .skillrows{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .skillrows dt{padding-bottom:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .skillrows dd{border-top:0;padding-top:.2rem}
  .skillrows dt:first-of-type{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
  .facts{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .facts dd{margin-bottom:.5rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{transition:none!important}}
</style>

    <div>
      <h1>Dr. Sachin Mishra</h1>
      <p class="pos">Principal Investigator, Materials Science</p>
      <p class="lead">I develop biosensors and the bio-interfaces behind them, and reinforce hydrogel matrices with cellulose nanocrystals. My work combines polymer and nanocomposite formulation with nanoscale characterization by atomic force microscopy and related techniques.</p>
      <dl class="facts">
        <dt>Position</dt><dd>Principal Investigator (ERC project), since April 2026</dd>
        <dt>Institution</dt><dd>Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC), Terrassa, Spain</dd>
        <dt>Degree</dt><dd>Ph.D. in Materials Science, Linköping University, 2019</dd>
        <dt>Interests</dt><dd>Biosensors, bio-interfaces, CNC hydrogel nanocomposites, AFM</dd>
      </dl>
      <div class="cta">
        <a class="btn primary" href="#publications">Publications</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="#contact">Contact</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="wrap">

  <section class="s" id="research">
    <div class="row">
      <h2>Research</h2>
      <div>
        <ul class="areas">
          <li>
            <h3>Cellulose nanocrystal-reinforced hydrogels</h3>
            <p>Nanocomposite matrices tuned for mechanical strength, optical clarity and interfacial behaviour.</p>
          </li>
          <li>
            <h3>Functional bio-interfaces</h3>
            <p>Surface chemistries that switch on and off, and connect biological recognition to an electronic signal.</p>
          </li>
          <li>
            <h3>Biosensor development</h3>
            <p>Label-free, real-time sensing chips, from graphene oxide capacitive devices to nanoporous metasurfaces.</p>
          </li>
          <li>
            <h3>Nanoscale characterization</h3>
            <p>AFM in liquid, force spectroscopy and magnetic force microscopy to measure morphology, surface potential and mechanics.</p>
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="s" id="experience">
    <div class="row">
      <h2>Experience</h2>
      <ol class="jobs">
        <li class="job">
          <div class="when">Apr 2026 to present</div>
          <div>
            <h3>Principal Investigator, ERC project</h3>
            <p class="where">Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC), Terrassa, Spain</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Engineering CNC-reinforced hydrogel matrices and optimizing mechanical, optical and interfacial properties.</li>
              <li>Designing nanostructured polymer-hybrid systems and analysing signal delivery and structural stability.</li>
              <li>Characterizing polymer materials with AFM in liquid, force spectroscopy and MFM.</li>
              <li>Managing laboratory equipment and safety, and training junior researchers on standard operating procedures.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="job">
          <div class="when">Jun 2022 to Feb 2026</div>
          <div>
            <h3>Principal Investigator, Maria Zambrano Fellow</h3>
            <p class="where">Universitat Rovira i Virgili (URV), Spain</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Led formulation and analytical characterization of micron-scale porous materials and tailored polymer surface chemistries.</li>
              <li>Designed and validated experimental protocols for durability, repeatability and functional reliability.</li>
              <li>Presented technical findings to international project partners and stakeholders.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="job">
          <div class="when">May 2019 to Apr 2022</div>
          <div>
            <h3>Research Professor</h3>
            <p class="where">RFIC group, Kwangwoon University, Seoul, South Korea</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Designed miniaturized glass-based interdigitated capacitor biochips for label-free, real-time detection.</li>
              <li>Built a reusable graphene oxide-modified sensing chip for SARS-CoV-2, with MATLAB simulation of the glass substrate.</li>
              <li>Fabricated AAO nanopore metasurface biosensors for biomolecular detection.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="job">
          <div class="when">2016 to 2019</div>
          <div>
            <h3>Ph.D. researcher, Materials Science</h3>
            <p class="where">Linköping University, Sweden, with the University of the Free State, South Africa</p>
            <ul><li>Thesis: “On/off-switchable bio-interfaces for triggered bioelectronics”.</li></ul>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="job">
          <div class="when">Jul 2014 to Apr 2016</div>
          <div>
            <h3>Junior Executive, vaccine process development</h3>
            <p class="where">Panacea Biotec Limited, India</p>
            <ul>
              <li>PCV-13: polysaccharide purification for 13 strains and CRM-197 conjugation.</li>
              <li>MenACWY: fermentation, tangential flow filtration, chromatography and lyophilization of purified polysaccharide.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </li>
      </ol>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="s" id="skills">
    <div class="row">
      <h2>Skills and techniques</h2>
      <dl class="skillrows">
        <dt>Characterization</dt>
        <dd>AFM (liquid, force spectroscopy, MFM), FE-SEM, HR-TEM, XRD, X-ray CT, Raman, FT-IR, UV-Vis, EIS, optical microscopy</dd>
        <dt>Polymers and formulation</dt>
        <dd>Hydrogel nanocomposites, cellulose nanocrystals, surface functionalization, micellar polymers, porous and 2D materials, masterbatches</dd>
        <dt>Process and separation</dt>
        <dd>Scale-up workflows, design of experiments, tangential flow filtration, column chromatography, lyophilization, precipitation</dd>
        <dt>Quality and tools</dt>
        <dd>GLP and GDP, technical report writing, MATLAB, GraphPad, Origin, SOLIDWORKS, project management</dd>
      </dl>
    </div>
  </section>

<script>
(function(){
  var nav=document.getElementById('nav'),menu=document.getElementById('menu');
  menu.addEventListener('click',function(){var o=nav.classList.toggle('open');menu.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o)});
  nav.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target.tagName==='A'){nav.classList.remove('open');menu.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}});
  document.getElementById('yr').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
  var links=document.querySelectorAll('#nav a'),map={};
  links.forEach(function(a){map[a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)]=a});
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){links.forEach(function(a){a.removeAttribute('aria-current')});var a=map[e.target.id];if(a)a.setAttribute('aria-current','true')}
    })},{rootMargin:'-35% 0px -60% 0px'});
    Object.keys(map).forEach(function(id){var s=document.getElementById(id);if(s)io.observe(s)});
  }
})();
</script>
